newsitem.title: UK: Guinness Peat calls off Gowrings bid.
newsitem.headline: Guinness Peat calls off Gowrings bid.

text.p: Guinness Peat Group Plc said on Thursday it would not proceed with its offer to buy British motor dealerships to fast food company Gowrings Plc.
The life assurance and investment company said it had been unable to conduct further talks about the offer, which Gowrings previously rejected.

"Guinness Peat remains convinced that Gowrings' prospects are limited by the modest scale of its disparate businesses and that it would benefit from being part of a larger group," the company said in a statement.

"Guinness Peat has noted the board of Gowrings' comments regarding the company's growth potential and future profitability and, as the largest single shareholder in Gowrings, looks forward to the delivery of this improved performance," it added.
Earlier this month, Gowrings said Guinness Peat's offer was unwelcome and failed to reflect its true value.
Guinness Peat, which has an estimated 14 percent stake in Gowrings, had hoped to secure a recommendation from the company at a price of not less than 90p per share cash with a loan note alternative.
Gowrings' shares were marked down 8.5p at 76.5p in afternoon trade, while Guinness Peat was flat at 35p.
